title: Python list --limit defaults to 50; Rust has no --limit (parity gap)
description:
## Intent

As a Kanbus CLI user, I want `kbs list` / `kanbus list` to show every matching issue by default, with `--limit` as an explicit opt-in cap that both Python and Rust honor identically, so that large boards are not silently truncated and the two CLIs stay in spec parity.

## Current violation

- Python `python/src/kanbus/cli.py` `--limit` defaults to 50 and slices at `issues = issues[:limit]`.
- Rust `kbs list` (`rust/src/cli.rs` `Commands::List`) has no `--limit` flag at all (`kbs list --limit 20` is `unexpected argument`).
- This violates AGENTS.md spec-parity: Python and Rust must produce identical behavior for the same inputs.

## Target behavior (Gherkin)

```gherkin
Feature: List command result limit
  As a Kanbus user
  I want list to show all matching issues by default
  And to optionally cap results with --limit
  So that Python and Rust CLIs stay in parity

  Scenario: List defaults to no limit
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And more than 50 issues exist
    When I run "kanbus list"
    Then the command should succeed
    And stdout should list every matching issue

  Scenario: List --limit N returns at most N issues
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And more than 3 issues exist
    When I run "kanbus list --limit 3"
    Then the command should succeed
    And stdout should contain at most 3 issue rows

  Scenario: List --limit 0 means no limit
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And more than 50 issues exist
    When I run "kanbus list --limit 0"
    Then the command should succeed
    And stdout should list every matching issue
```

Prefer adding these scenarios to `features/queries/queries.feature` (existing list spec) rather than a new file, unless a separate file is clearly cleaner.

## Related hygiene (same slice)

- Delete untracked stale backups in the **primary clone** (worktrees will not copy them): `python/src/kanbus/cli.py.bak`, `.bak2`, `.bak4`, `.backup` under `/Users/home/Projects/Kanbus`.
- Keep `CLI_REFERENCE.md` `--limit` docs consistent with default 0 (no limit). Update Rust help/docs if `--limit` is added. Fix Python help text that currently says "Matches Beads default."

## Out of scope

- Do not deploy. Do not touch Chattic.us. Do not merge to main.
- Wiki `--json`/`--limit` (kbs-c445a6) is a different command.

## Definition of Done

- Gherkin for `--limit` exists and both implementations pass it.
- Python default is 0; `--limit` remains opt-in; `--limit 0` is unlimited.
- Rust `kbs list` accepts `--limit` with the same semantics.
- Stale `.bak`/`.backup` copies of `cli.py` are gone from the primary clone.
- Docs match. `pytest` and `cargo test` (if Rust touched) pass.
- PR to `develop` is open; do not merge.

- Branch: `cursor/kanbus-list-cap-fix-4a21` from `origin/develop`
